8809.name: Mithi
8809.why: CWC draws the Mithi (as "Mahim") from the hills a kilometre north of Vihar Lake. The river leaves the lake at the Vihar Lake Dam; course from the OpenStreetMap "Mithi River" waterway relation 6245575, dam to Mahim Creek.

16612.name: Mithari or Jojri
16612.why: Rises in the hills near Poondloo, Nagaur (the Jojari source on Wikipedia) and runs to the Luni east of Jodhpur. CWC stops the line about 5 km short and records it as inland drainage. Continued down the HydroRIVERS reaches to the Luni.

16613.name: Jojri
16613.why: The Jojari flows through Jodhpur, past Doli and Dhawa, and joins the Luni near Balotra (Mongabay, 2025; Wikipedia). CWC stops the line short and records it as inland drainage. Continued down the HydroRIVERS reaches to the Luni.
